narrative.overview: This is the field journal of a learning designer who studies how humans actually change before she designs anything. The page is warm paper, not a screen. Bauhaus Bool sets the display, lowercase and enormous; JetBrains Mono sets the chrome, the field-note stamps and call numbers that prove the work was observed and catalogued. Color is used with discipline: paper and graphite carry the page, and the three brand colors arrive as signal on small percentages of any surface. It rejects generic L&D voice, the AI-hype register, SaaS-cream portfolios, and the hero-metric template.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground with tactile grain, never stark white
Bauhaus display, lowercase, oversized; JetBrains Mono for all small chrome
Work catalogued under call numbers, not laid out as cards
Three brand colors as signal, disciplined to small surface percentages
Direct, credibility-forward, slightly edgy; no filler, no jargon

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: The page ground is Warm Ash Paper (#f2efe8), never #fff and never pure #000. Every neutral is tinted warm. Pure white appears only as an input's focused state.

rules.name: The Small-Magenta Rule
rules.body: Bright Editorial Magenta (#EC008C) is for display and true accents only, ~24px and up. Smaller magenta uses Magenta Ink (#BC006B) on light or Magenta Lift (#F24DAF) on dark.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Lime, blue, and magenta are signal, not surface. On any screen they occupy a small percentage; paper and graphite do the structural work.

rules.name: The Mono-Chrome Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is only small editorial chrome: kickers, stamps, codes, captions. Forbidden for display and body copy.

rules.name: The Lowercase Rule
rules.body: The display face and the brand wordmark are always lowercase.

rules.name: The Long-Throw Rule
rules.body: Shadows are long, soft, and low-opacity with negative spread. Surfaces are flat at rest and lift only on hover or focus.

dos: Do ground every page in Warm Ash Paper (#f2efe8) with the grain layer. Tint every neutral warm.
Do keep JetBrains Mono to small chrome: kickers, stamps, call numbers, captions.
Do set the display lowercase and oversized, and let a lime curtain bar reveal it.
Do file work under call numbers with mono metadata.
Do use Magenta Ink (#BC006B) / Magenta Lift (#F24DAF) for small magenta text; reserve bright #EC008C for display.
Do lift surfaces with long, soft, negative-spread shadows, only on hover or focus.
donts: Don't write 'passionate about learning' energy, or any generic L&D filler.
Don't use the AI-hype voice: bare-category headlines, aspirational reinvention frames, or trademarked-framework theater.
Don't ship a SaaS-cream portfolio, or the hero-metric template.
Don't build identical card grids of icon + heading + text.
Don't use gradient text or glassmorphism.
Don't use a border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't use an em dash anywhere except the official tagline.
Don't use pure #fff as a page ground or pure #000 for text.
